propositions: Compaction writes SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired files to the working tree, then commits; if the detached sweep process is killed before commit, the tree is left dirty with untracked regenerable artifacts.

Union merge in reconverge runs 'git merge origin/tickets'; when a peer has pushed those same *.retired/SNAPSHOT paths, git aborts with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge' because the paths exist untracked locally.

Push recovery cannot self-heal this abort because git reset --hard ignores untracked files and git stash without -u does not capture them, causing permanent wedge and stranding local ticket events off origin.
The fix relocates only the exact untracked paths git names (from the abort error message) into a git-common-dir quarantine, retries the merge once, and preserves both parents on success.

Tracked .archived files deleted during interrupted compaction remain dirty in the working tree, causing git status to report tracked deletions that block LLM plan-review and close operations even after writes are unblocked.
